notes.title: "The Dreamlands: Aisling's Quest" coming soon. Quick updates.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6789996/38ed9162b31a0702bde7f77700f514db41694fb8.png[/img]

Hello all!

I've been working on the latest details, fixes and improvements for "The Dreamlands: Aisling's Quest" and everything should be ready for its release next month!

So, what have I been up to? Well, other than working on fixing issues and improving performance on lower-end systems, I have been looking into translations for the game. Right now, it's already translated into Spanish and German, and I will soon have French and Italian subtitles as well. On top of that, I found a couple of really cool voice actors that are giving life to the characters, so that is going to be a big plus!

I've made sure the game can run on systems with integrated graphics, and I'm constantly making more changes to improve performance even more.

Another thing I am looking into are achievements, so I will add those to the game as soon as I'm done with the other things I need to polish. I also want to add trading cards, but thanks to the "fake games" problem Steam only activates trading cards after the game has reached "a certain threshold" (I think they mean "until it reaches a specific number of players"), so I think we'll have to wait a little longer for that.

So yeah! If you like mystery casual games, or point-and-click adventure games follow and wishlist it! "The Dreamlands: Aisling's Quest" will release on Windows and Mac during the first half of April.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/821550/The_Dreamlands_Aislings_Quest/

notes.title: Enola 90% off and Steam Awards
notes.content:
Hello all!

You surely have already noticed Enola is 90% off. Thanks to those who have supported and bought the game these years. It means a lot, because I was in constant fear while working on this game, since I didn't know how people would react to the plot and the very dark themes, but your support and comments show it was all worth in the end.

Here's a crazy idea. How about you nominate Enola for the "haunts my dreams" steam awardy? I know it's a long shot and it has pretty much zero chances of winning, but it'd be cool if it did.

The Nightmare from Beyond is also on sale (15% off), so you may want to help that game too?
http://store.steampowered.com/app/684340/The_Nightmare_from_Beyond/

Peace!

notes.title: Ïa! Ïa! Shub-Niggurath! The Nightmare from Beyond release 2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6789996/953d9726171367d9f6b7bc3f7d68ee8fe3f69608.jpg[/img]

Hi all. The Nightmare from Beyond early access release 2 is now available and will download automatically as soon as you open your Steam client.

What's new in this update:

[list]
[*]A new intro that provides some context to the story and the game world.
[*]The intro level also has a locker thingy that will be used to switch outfits (there will be unlockable outfits in the game).
[*]Now in the "chase sequence" you get a very cool and interesting animation when the creature grabs you.
[*]Fixed audio levels, so you no longer run the risk of going deaf due to some audios being too loud.
[*]Controller support for the DualShock 4, Xbox 360 and Xbox One, Steam Controller and standard XInput controllers.
[*]Besides making the game control easier, controller support includes vibration, making some parts of the game very interesting.
[*]Changes to Sanja's skirt cloth simulation.
[*]Added a "gamepad help" screen as well, since controls cannot be remapped yet.
[/list]


http://store.steampowered.com/app/684340/The_Nightmare_from_Beyond/

notes.title: Alien girls, mysterious lands, cosmic horror. Soon on Early Access
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/684340/extras/tnfb_gif.jpg[/img] 

Hello all! 

I'm happy to announce that our next game, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684340]The Nightmare from Beyond [/url] will release soon on Steam Early Access. The Nightmare from Beyond is a cosmic-horror third person platformer inspired by the works of H. P. Lovecraft.

Like Enola, it will have a big emphasis on story, but that story will be delivered using different methods (that means no more countless notes and huge walls of text!). However, it will also have a bigger emphasis on gameplay since it's a 3d platformer.

Please visit [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/684340]the store [/url]page for more.

In the meantime, you can check out a short demo [url=https://thedomaginarium.itch.io/tnfb-prea]here [/url]

notes.title: Models and endings gallery, new outfit, a couple of fixes
notes.content:
Hello all!

There's another update coming today (it's already live now). It includes a couple of fixes and also a couple of new features.

After watching a couple of LPs I noticed people often don't realize there's more than one ending (actually a few people have also asked if there's more than one ending). I realized there's nothing in the game that lets you know there's more than one ending, so I added a "gallery" where you can watch all the endings you have unlocked already, as well as character models. Enola's outfits are viewable after they are unlocked.


I also added a new unlockable outfit. It's somewhat weird to see her wearing pants when all her outfits are dresses or skirts.


Also, endings now have subtitles. This will be more useful when I add more languages. I'm still looking into the best way to do it, maybe crowdsource the subtitles (post the dialogues online so people collaborate with translation), not sure, but if you think that would be a good idea let me know.

Fixes:
There was an issue with the crouching that caused the character to stop walking when you pressed the crouch key. Long story short, it was related to the physics inside the engine, but I managed to fix it. Now, if you press the crouch key while walking, the character just crouches and continues moving without any interruption.

Fixed some problems with collisions in different areas.

notes.title: Duplicate items fix, ending fix, a costume variation, and other things
notes.content:
Hello all, I made a few changes to the game, addressing these problems:

Being able to pick the same item (keys) over and over in some cases.
The game not loading the ending in certain situations.
Different issues related to the monster in the fourth level.
The boss battle not loading the alternate costumes.

I also added another alternate costume. It's a variation of the base costume, but has no corset. I also plan to add more alternate costumes in the future.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Hello all,

There have been some updates in these last days, but today I uploaded the first "big" patch. That one fixes some issues with the game that prevent you from getting any further:

made some changes to the island to prevent people from wandering too much, since that can cause people to get lost (and bored) easily
an issue with the big elevator in the factory, where you can't navigate it up or down
I put a few hints in the factory level to make it easier to understand and know what to do
an issue with the "numbers" puzzle, also in the factory, where the game gets stuck
being unable to close the message boxes. Now all the message boxes can be closed with the ESC key as well.
the little bottle puzzle was causing too many problems, so I changed it to make it simpler

I'm still trying to figure out the issues some mention where you get duplicate items (like more than 2 of the same key, etc). If you can point me to specific scenarios where that happens, you'd help me a lot.
Again, sorry for the inconvenience and for all these bugs. You deserved a game that was running trouble-free from day one.

By the way, Nick (the music guy, heh) told me he can give a copy of the soundtrack to the first one who gets the good ending and the secret post-credits scene.
